description: Implementation of the rx::Image11 class, which manages Direct3D 11 texture resources, staging textures, and related operations such as mipmap generation, copying, loading data, and handling texture storage associations within ANGLE's D3D11 renderer.

classes.name: Image11
classes.description: Manages Direct3D 11 texture resources, staging textures, and related operations such as mipmap generation, copying, loading data, and handling texture storage associations within ANGLE's D3D11 renderer.

methods.name: GenerateMipmap
methods.description: Generates mipmaps for a texture by mapping source and destination textures, applying a format-specific mip generation function, and marking the destination as dirty.

methods.name: CopyImage
methods.description: Copies a specified region from a source image to a destination image, with optional flipping and alpha premultiplication, using mapped subresources.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Checks if the image has been modified and needs to be uploaded or reprocessed.

methods.name: copyToStorage
methods.description: Copies image data to a TextureStorage, managing staging textures and texture associations.

methods.name: verifyAssociatedStorageValid
methods.description: Asserts that the associated storage matches the provided TextureStorage.

methods.name: recoverFromAssociatedStorage
methods.description: Recovers image data from associated TextureStorage if needed, copying subresources back into staging textures.

methods.name: disassociateStorage
methods.description: Disassociates the image from its current TextureStorage.

methods.name: redefine
methods.description: Redefines the image with new type, format, size, and optionally releases previous storage.

methods.name: getDXGIFormat
methods.description: Returns the DXGI format of the image.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads pixel data into the image from client memory, handling format and pitch calculations.

methods.name: loadCompressedData
methods.description: Loads compressed pixel data into the image.

methods.name: copyFromTexStorage
methods.description: Copies data from a TextureStorage into the image.

methods.name: copyFromFramebuffer
methods.description: Copies data from a framebuffer attachment into the image, with format conversion if necessary.

methods.name: copyWithoutConversion
methods.description: Performs a direct copy of subresource data between textures when formats match.

methods.name: getStagingTexture
methods.description: Ensures staging texture exists and retrieves it along with its subresource index.

methods.name: createStagingTexture
methods.description: Creates a staging texture based on current image properties.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the staging texture resource for CPU access, recovering from storage if needed.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps the staging texture resource after CPU access.
